brief.subject: AAdvantage card fee jumps to $150; holiday budgets climb
brief.headline: Popular Airline Card Raises Annual Fee to $150 as Holiday Budgets Swell
brief.dek: An American Airlines co-branded card adds $51 to its yearly fee, and shoppers expect to spend nearly $200 more on gifts.
brief.lede: The Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select card's annual fee is going up $51, to $150. Cardholders should check whether the new perks offset the higher charge.

sections.heading: Airline Card Fee Rises to $150
bullets: The Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select World Elite Mastercard is raising its annual fee by $51.
The new yearly fee is $150, a cost cardholders pay whether or not they fly.
New perks include a $100 in-flight credit each year, worth it only if you actually buy onboard.
Compare the added benefits to your real spending before your renewal date hits.

sections.heading: Holiday Gift Budgets Climb
bullets: Shoppers expect to spend nearly $200 more on gifts, on average, than last year, a NerdWallet survey found.
Tariff-related price increases may be part of the reason, so the same gifts could simply cost more.
Setting a firm gift budget now can help avoid card balances that linger into the new year.

sections.heading: Bigger Sign-Up Bonuses on Atmos Cards
bullets: Two Atmos Rewards Visa cards raised their welcome offers to as much as 100,000 points.
Large bonuses usually require meeting a spending threshold, which can push households to overspend.
Weigh any annual fee against the bonus before applying for a new card.

brief.seo_description: AAdvantage Platinum Select annual fee rises $51 to $150, holiday gift budgets up nearly $200, and Atmos cards boost welcome offers.

items.title: American Airlines Revamps Platinum Select Credit Card, Increases Annual Fee to $150
items.snippet: The Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select World Elite Mastercard is increasing its annual fee by $51 and adding new benefits like an annual $100 in-flight credit.

items.title: 2025 Holiday Spending Report
items.snippet: Holiday shoppers plan to spend nearly $200 more, on average, on gifts this year than last year, potentially due to tariff-related price increases, a new NerdWallet survey finds.

items.title: Atmos Credit Cards Increase Welcome Offers Up to 100,000 Points
items.snippet: The Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® credit card and Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite® credit card increased their welcome offers. Find out how they compare.
